Container.Name: linkbreeze
Container.Overview: LinkBreeze is the self-hosted Linktree alternative. One public page holds all your links, backed by a real admin dashboard: privacy-first analytics, QR codes, 11 built-in themes with a full customizer, link scheduling, and a migration wizard that imports from Linktree and other platforms in about 30 seconds. Single container with SQLite included, zero client-side JavaScript on the public page. On first open the setup wizard creates your admin account; updates install from the Apps tab.
